text: Integral action accumulates error over time. It can keep changing the control output even when the instantaneous error is small.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: John D. Hedengren, APMonitor Process Dynamics and Control, PI lesson; https://apmonitor.com/pdc/index.php/Main/ProportionalIntegralControl. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: A PI controller combines a response to present error with a response to accumulated error, often removing the offset left by proportional control.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: John D. Hedengren, APMonitor Process Dynamics and Control, PI lesson; https://apmonitor.com/pdc/index.php/Main/ProportionalIntegralControl. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: When switching from manual operation to automatic control, matching the controller's initial output to the current output can avoid an abrupt jump.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: John D. Hedengren, APMonitor Process Dynamics and Control, PI lesson; https://apmonitor.com/pdc/index.php/Main/ProportionalIntegralControl. Consulted 2026-10-13.
